name: fire
instructions: An enemy is lined up with the crosshair, so firing now would hit it.

name: turn
instructions: Aim at the nearest enemy, close the distance to it, or search for one.

options.name: left
options.description: The nearest enemy is well to the left of the crosshair, so turn left toward it

options.name: nudge_left
options.description: The nearest enemy is slightly to the left of the crosshair, so turn left a little

options.name: right
options.description: The nearest enemy is well to the right of the crosshair, so turn right toward it

options.name: nudge_right
options.description: The nearest enemy is slightly to the right of the crosshair, so turn right a little

options.name: hold
options.description: The nearest enemy is lined up with the crosshair and close, so stop and shoot

options.name: advance
options.description: The nearest enemy is lined up with the crosshair but not close, so walk toward it

options.name: scan
options.description: No enemy is in sight, so walk and turn to search the room
